description: Search matches by ID, date, round, category, draw or tournament level. Returns each match with its tournament, round, both teams with their players and seeds, scheduled time, court, status, score, winner and duration. To list all matches of a tournament, use the "list-tournament-matches" tool.

after_date.description: Filter matches played after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

before_date.description: Filter matches played before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

category.description: Category of the match. Either `men` or `women`.

draw.description: Draw the matches belong to: `main`, `qualy`, `group` or `placement` (team tournaments only), or `all` for every draw in a single list. Defaults to `main`: the other draws are only returned when explicitly requested.

id.description: Match ID(s) to retrieve, comma-separated (e.g. `1,2,3`). Only returns matches of the default `draw=main` unless `draw=all` is passed.

level.description: Filter by tournament level(s), comma-separated. Premier Padel: major, p1, p2, finals. FIP tour: fip_platinum, fip_gold, fip_silver, fip_other. World Padel Tour (historical): wpt_master, wpt_1000, wpt_500, wpt_final. Padel Pro Tour (historical): ppt_master, ppt_final, ppt_international, ppt_promotional, ppt_other.

order_by.description: Order of the sorting, either `asc` or `desc`.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Results are paginated: check `meta` (`current_page`, `last_page`, `total`) in the response and request further pages with this parameter until you have all the results you need.

per_page.description: Number of results per page (1-50). Use a small value when you only need the top results (e.g. 1 for the most recent match), or 50 to minimize pages when you need the complete list.

round.description: Filter matches by round (1 = Final, 2 = Semifinal, 4 = Quarterfinal, 8 = Round of 16, 16 = Round of 32, 32 = Round of 64, 0 = group stage of team tournaments).

name: search-matches
